evals.prompt: Draft a durable record of why the team chose a shared non-production account over one account per environment: lower operational overhead, with isolation enforced by resource policies. The team accepted this choice.
evals.expected_output: Records the stated tradeoff and accepted choice without inventing additional evidence.
assertions: Records the stated tradeoff and accepted choice without inventing additional evidence.

evals.prompt: Draft a replacement decision for an accepted record choosing one database per tenant. The proposed shared database uses row-level isolation to reduce operational overhead; acceptance is pending. Explain old status.
evals.expected_output: Leaves the old record accepted while the replacement is only proposed.
assertions: Leaves the old record accepted while the replacement is only proposed.

evals.prompt: Assess whether we need a new record: an accepted decision requires encrypted backups, and a recent review reaffirmed it without changing the choice or rationale.
evals.expected_output: Explains why reaffirming an unchanged accepted decision does not itself require a new record.
assertions: Explains why reaffirming an unchanged accepted decision does not itself require a new record.
